## Asking a Question

Open a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/thisis-romar/ma2-onPC-MCP/issues/new) and include:
- What you're trying to do (in MA2 or agent terms)
- Your MCP tier (COMMUNITY / PROFESSIONAL / ENTERPRISE)
- MA2 software version and platform (onPC / physical console)
- Error output or telnet feedback

## Reporting a Bug

Use the [Bug Report](https://github.com/thisis-romar/ma2-onPC-MCP/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) template.

## Security Vulnerabilities

**Do not open a public issue.** Use [GitHub Private Vulnerability Report](https://github.com/thisis-romar/ma2-onPC-MCP/security/advisories/new) or see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
